summary_en: SERAKU executed a block acquisition of 172,100 shares (1.30% of outstanding shares) at 1,452 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on October 30, 2026, for a total of 249.89 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On October 29, 2026, SERAKU's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 1,000,000 shares (7.55% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 1 billion yen through October 30, 2026–June 30, 2027, using both ToSTNeT-3 and open market purchases. On the same day, the company executed the first block purchase, acquiring 172,100 shares (1.30% of outstanding shares) at 1,452 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on October 30, 2026, for a total of 249.89 million yen. The closing price on October 29 was 1,452 yen, which became the fixed acquisition price. This execution represents the first drawdown from the authorized buyback program approved by the board.
